meta.note: Programmes, networks and funders that help countries close gaps in a technical area. Area codes follow the JEE third edition. A listing is a pointer, not an endorsement; check each programme's current eligibility and status.

programmes.name: WHO Strategic Partnership for Health Security and Emergency Preparedness (SPH) portal
programmes.desc: Maps assessments (JEE, SPAR, AAR), national action plans and which partners fund what, per country.

programmes.name: Global Health Security Agenda (GHSA)
programmes.desc: Coalition of countries and organisations with action packages per technical area; a route to find peer countries and donors.

programmes.name: The Pandemic Fund
programmes.desc: Grants to strengthen surveillance, laboratories and workforce in low- and middle-income countries.

programmes.name: International Association of National Public Health Institutes (IANPHI)
programmes.desc: Peer support to create and strengthen national public health institutes, including staff exchange and twinning.

programmes.name: Global Health Partnerships Programme (GHPP-NL)
programmes.org: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
programmes.desc: Government-to-government partnerships since 2023 with Kenya, China, Colombia, Indonesia, South Africa, India and Egypt on pandemic preparedness, AMR and climate and health.

programmes.name: RIVM global health security programmes
programmes.desc: Dutch national institute's international work on AMR, biosecurity, CBRN preparedness and IHR, often as WHO Collaborating Centre.

programmes.name: Global Health Protection Programme (GHPP-DE)
programmes.desc: German programme in which RKI, BfR, FLI, PEI and others run partnerships on outbreaks, laboratories, One Health and emergency medical teams.

programmes.name: IHR Strengthening Project
programmes.org: UK Health Security Agency (UK FCDO funded)
programmes.desc: UK support to partner countries' IHR core capacities, mainly in Africa and Asia.

programmes.name: Joint Action Global Health Impact (JA GHI)
programmes.org: EU4Health joint action of EU member states
programmes.desc: EU member states working together to maximise the impact of the EU Global Health Strategy, including communities of practice in health security.

programmes.name: SHARP Joint Action (Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness in the EU)
programmes.org: EU4Health/3rd Health Programme, coordinated by Finland (THL)
programmes.desc: EU joint action (2021–2024) on IHR core capacities, preparedness planning, laboratories and training in EU and neighbouring countries.

programmes.name: EU-JAMRAI 2 (Joint Action on AMR and healthcare-associated infections)
programmes.desc: Helps EU countries put One Health AMR action plans into practice: stewardship, infection prevention, surveillance.

programmes.name: The Fleming Fund
programmes.org: UK Department of Health and Social Care
programmes.desc: Funds AMR surveillance in human and animal health in low- and middle-income countries.

programmes.name: WOAH PVS Pathway and IHR-PVS National Bridging Workshops
programmes.org: World Organisation for Animal Health (with WHO)
programmes.desc: Evaluates veterinary services and links them to IHR capacities through joint human–animal workshops.

programmes.name: One Health Joint Plan of Action (2022–2026)
programmes.desc: Joint plan and tools for multisectoral One Health coordination on zoonoses, food safety and AMR.

programmes.name: INFOSAN (International Food Safety Authorities Network)
programmes.desc: Network of national food safety authorities for rapid information exchange during international food safety events.

programmes.name: Global Partnership against the Spread of Weapons and Materials of Mass Destruction
programmes.desc: Funds and matches biosecurity and CBRN projects; a route for biosafety and biosecurity support.

programmes.name: EU CBRN Risk Mitigation Centres of Excellence
programmes.desc: Regional secretariats and projects on biosafety, biosecurity, chemical and radiological preparedness in 60+ partner countries.

programmes.name: WHO BioHub System
programmes.desc: Safe, voluntary sharing of pathogen materials between laboratories under agreed biosafety and biosecurity conditions.

programmes.name: International Federation of Biosafety Associations (IFBA)
programmes.desc: Biosafety associations, professional certification and training in biorisk management.

programmes.name: African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
programmes.desc: Pan-African laboratory network: quality management (SLMTA), accreditation, AMR laboratory capacity.

programmes.name: TEPHINET (field epidemiology training network)
programmes.desc: Global network of field epidemiology training programmes (FETP) and their graduates.

programmes.name: ECDC Fellowship Programme (EPIET/EUPHEM)
programmes.desc: Two-year field epidemiology and public health microbiology training for EU/EEA countries.

programmes.name: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence
programmes.desc: Collaborative surveillance: data sharing, analytics and decision-support tools for countries.

programmes.name: UNITED4Surveillance
programmes.desc: EU joint action on integrated surveillance of infectious diseases, including digital and genomic surveillance.

programmes.name: 7-1-7 Alliance
programmes.org: Resolve to Save Lives and partners
programmes.desc: Countries use the 7-1-7 target (detect in 7 days, notify in 1, respond in 7) to find and fix bottlenecks.

programmes.name: GOARN (Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network)
programmes.desc: Deploys experts from partner institutions to outbreaks; also offers training for responders.

programmes.name: WHO Emergency Medical Teams (EMT) initiative
programmes.desc: Standards, classification and mentoring for national and international emergency medical teams.

programmes.name: EU Health Task Force
programmes.desc: ECDC experts who support EU and non-EU countries in preparedness and response.

programmes.name: HERA procurement and stockpiling (incl. rescEU)
programmes.desc: Joint procurement and EU-level stockpiles of medical countermeasures.

programmes.name: JA TERROR (joint action on biological and chemical terror attacks)
programmes.desc: EU joint action (2019–2021) linking health and security sectors for biological and chemical attacks.

programmes.name: RCCE Collective Service
programmes.desc: Tools, case studies and support for risk communication and community engagement.

programmes.name: IAEA Emergency Preparedness Review (EPREV)
programmes.desc: Peer review of national arrangements for nuclear and radiological emergencies.

programmes.name: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance
programmes.desc: Vaccine funding, supply and outbreak stockpiles (with ICG) for lower-income countries.
